item.title: Legal Battle Over Matric Results Publication Intensifies as Regulator Appeals Court Ruling
item.description: The Information Regulator of South Africa has filed an application to appeal a Pretoria High Court’s ruling that favoured the Department of Basic Education on December 12. The appeal opposes the publishing of matriculants' examination numbers in newspapers.

item.title: Economists cautiously optimistic as SA enters 2026 on firmer growth footing
item.description: Economists have remained positive for 2026 for a year of economic growth in South Africa.

item.title: Hainan Free Trade Port Launch Creates New Pathways for South African Trade and Investment
item.description: China’s decision to advance the “independent customs operation” of the Hainan Free Trade Port marks a significant milestone in its broader reform and opening-up agenda.

item.title: Light up for DJ Warras: Murder case returns to court as family appeals for solidarity
item.description: The murder case of Warrick Robert Stock, popularly known as DJ Warras, returns to the Johannesburg Magistrate’s Court on Tuesday, as his family called on South Africans to show solidarity by lighting candles and marking the day in quiet remembrance.

item.title: City sees 28.5% drop in emergency incidents
item.description: Officers recovered two firearms in Hanover Park in separate incidents.

item.title: AmaZulu King Misuzulu's rare public appearance amid continued ritual isolation during First Fruits Festival
item.description: YOUNG Zulu regiments at the First Fruits Festival in eMashobeni Royal Palace in oPhongolo, northern KwaZulu-Natal where King Misuzulu kaZwelithini made a rare and brief public appearance after weeks of ritual isolation. The festival heralds the harvest season with the blessing of the Zulu King.

item.title: The Unjust Military Attack on Venezuela: A Violation of Sovereignty
item.description: Demonstrators gather outside the Daniel Patrick Moynihan United States Courthouse as ousted Venezuelan president Nicolas Maduro awaits his arraignment hearing. The violation of Venezuela’s sovereignty represents the culmination of a prolonged campaign of regime change initiated in response to Hugo Chávez’s Bolivarian Revolution, says the writer.
